physical_anchor: Enriches uranium (SWU) into low-enriched uranium (LEU) and HALEU fuel via centrifuge cascades at its Piketon, Ohio plant, and fabricates related nuclear fuel components under DOE/commercial contracts.
value_chain_position: Conversion & enrichment layer — sells enriched uranium product (SWU/LEU/HALEU) and technical fuel services directly into the reactor fuel-cycle chain.
